command:
set -eu
date --iso-8601=seconds
systemctl show -p Version
dpkg-query -W systemd libnss-systemd libpam-systemd libsystemd-shared libsystemd0 libudev1 systemd-cryptsetup systemd-resolved systemd-sysv udev
dpkg --audit
systemctl is-active ssh docker systemd-resolved cloudflared bussassistent-backup.timer
ip route show default
getent ahostsv4 app.bussassistent.com
